assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production isometric building sprite atlas for the strategy game Auralis Wars. Reference image is the layout/camera/quality reference, not a design to recolor. Create a NEW distinctly shaped racial architecture set. EXACT 4 columns x 4 rows, equal cells, generous transparent gutters around EVERY object. All sixteen complete isolated buildings, nothing cropped, no ground tile, no background, no text or numbers. Orthographic isometric camera, roof and two walls visible, light upper left, contact shadows only, textured stone/wood/metal with crisp bevels, believable engineered structure, high-end painted 3D game rendering, NOT clay, NOT toy plastic. Keep each object within its cell. Preserve the exact category order: row1 headquarters, residence, gold mine with cart, lumber mill; row2 oil pump, steel foundry, warehouse, barracks; row3 vehicle workshop, aviation hangar, research lab, watchtower; row4 missile turret, wall segment, hospital, diplomatic hall. Every category must remain recognizable and have different function-specific geometry. RACE KHARUN: mountain forge clans. Heavy angular basalt blocks, terracotta and copper pitched roofs, iron braces, amber furnace light, chiseled geometric reliefs, fortified stone buttresses. Headquarters is a stepped citadel with copper signal dish, residence squat gabled mountain house, mine carved from dark rock, industry has brick chimneys and reinforced gantries, hospital has clear medical cross. Strong broad silhouettes. Bronze mechanical technology, no fantasy medieval weapons. Palette charcoal stone, red copper, muted ochre.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production animation sprite atlas for Auralis Wars, an isometric military strategy game. Create EXACTLY SIX EQUAL COLUMNS and FIVE EQUAL ROWS, 30 isolated sprites in a regular grid. Canvas landscape 1536 by 1280. NO labels, lettering, border, ground tiles or background. Each cell has wide transparent gutters, full subject inside cell, consistent foot baseline at 88% cell height. Crisp detailed painted 3D game assets, visible fabric, skin, bolts and metal bevels, natural non-plastic materials, slightly heroic proportions, not clay, not chibi. Orthographic isometric camera, three-quarter view facing down-right, upper-left daylight, no cast shadow. Within each character row every cell is the SAME character and SAME scale and clothes, changing only pose. Row1 CIVILIAN WORKER: cell1 idle holding tool, cell2 left leg forward walking, cell3 right leg forward walking, cell4 tool raised to gather resources, cell5 tool striking low, cell6 carrying a resource sack. Row2 RIFLE INFANTRY: cell1 idle weapon low, cell2 walking left leg forward, cell3 walking right leg forward, cell4 aiming rifle, cell5 firing rifle (tiny muzzle flash only), cell6 recoil stance. Row3 HEAVY SOLDIER with bulky armor and shoulder launcher: cell1 idle, cell2 left step, cell3 right step, cell4 aiming, cell5 firing, cell6 recoil. Row4 MEDIC/ENGINEER: cell1 idle with satchel, cell2 left step, cell3 right step, cell4 kneeling with scanner, cell5 arm extended healing/repairing, cell6 carrying medical case, NO rifle in this row. Row5 six DIFFERENT complete vehicles, all same isometric camera: cell1 armored scout buggy, cell2 heavy tracked tank, cell3 long-barrel tracked artillery, cell4 attack rotorcraft, cell5 jet aircraft, cell6 military patrol ship (NO water around it). Each vehicle wholly contained in its cell. HUMAN RACE AURORA: human adults with clearly human faces and warm tan skin, varied facial features per role, teal work shirts and steel blue helmets, navy military canvas uniforms, ivory and dark slate armor plates, brass unit markings. Worker has cap, gloves and pickaxe; rifle infantry wears open-face helmet; heavy soldier has broad shoulder armor; medic has ivory coat and utility scanner. Vehicles navy/ivory steel with brass details, real wheels/tracks/panel seams.
